notes.title: Once Upon a Jester - a theatrical, musical adventure is coming to PC in 2022!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40785394/1aadb1a2f0fc169eaac4224b266b2d4ecfb4dc83.png[/img]Hey everyone!

We are very glad to announce [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1668190/Once_Upon_a_Jester/]Once Upon a Jester[/url] - a new diamond in our publishing lineup!

Once Upon a Jester is being developed by Bonte Avond - a game studio made up of 4 musicians. They really like going with first ideas and putting lots of homemade indie music in their games. Always trying to be conscious of diversity in their games a- there’s a lot of jokes in Bonte Avond’s games, but never at anyone's expense. You may heard of them because of their previous game - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510630/Everybody_Wham_Wham/]Everybody Wham Wham[/url].

Check out our announcement trailer:
[previewyoutube=nQl4jVzUffI;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is a story about best friends Sok & Jester planning a mischievous scheme to steal the Royal Diamond! To complete their master plan, they must start an improv theatre show and outperform every other act - including their rivals, Hofnar & Bok. Only becoming the best show in the kingdom will get them invited to the Royal Theatrical Spectacle in the Royal Palace, where the king keeps his precious gem.

[img]https://dl.dropbox.com/s/uszg79x31gwk47a/1_GIF_genres615x215.gif[/img]

They embark on a grand adventure across a fantasy kingdom, meeting tons of wacky characters, performing improvised shows and singing their hearts out. Along the way, they unintentionally discover the freedom and joy of musical theatre. Will the pair change their wicked ways or do whatever it takes to get rich?

[img]https://dl.dropbox.com/s/16aq0ccwx0eeiyg/2_GIF_characters615x215.gif[/img]

[img]https://dl.dropbox.com/s/bc2hl6i3lls4l6h/4_GIF_soundtrack615x215.gif[/img]

Once Upon a Jester is coming soon on PCs and other platforms. Find out more about the game and stay updated by adding it to your Steam wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1668190/Once_Upon_a_Jester/

notes.title: What's up? We made a gig.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/cf510c9747e844f13645ffee1658b72015a4834e.jpg[/img]

We had a really great but busy time before we were able to take some vacation.

We worked really hard to give an experimental game music concert with music improvised to the game played in the real time. It was one of the Pixel Heaven 2017 afterparty gigs. We wanted to stream it and publish some official recordings. However, the local staff had some technical problems rendering some of our plans impossible to realize. 

[b]Fortunately, some of our gamedev friends recorded parts of the gig for us! Enjoy:[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s9DWzGA5FpA
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ck0XkIXdkb0

[h1]Members of the band:[/h1]
[b]Maciej Niedzielski[/b] (musician) - that bearded guy playing the piano
[b]Krzysztof Chomicki[/b] (level designer) - that bearded guy playing the bass
[b]Sebastian Krośkiewicz (me)[/b] (game designer) - that bearded guy playing the game (you can't see me in the videos)

Yes, we're all bearded, but they say beards are manly.

Despite having technical problems mentioned before (no recordings, delays, allowed to play only 13 minutes out of planned 30 etc.), we're happy that we managed to actually do all of this (it was my first time organizing a concert, yay!). Who knows, maybe we'll even do something similar in the future.

[h1]Demo version (already available in the Beta branch)[/h1]
We're also releasing BUTCHER's demo version soon. Not because it's gonna be particularly profitable, but simply because we want to do it. It's ready to be tested in the Beta branch (it requires you to start the game again or play the levels one-by-one in the level browser).

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/4a0812c172bb98e10f759a6d703e90e22fda6fff.png[/img]

The demo will offer 3 new levels and some new music. It takes place before the events of the main game. You start aboard the Mothership and take some calibration tests before you're allowed to go on your mission and seek your real targets.

We still need to fix some minor issues and do some tweaks, so we're waiting for your feedback!

[h1]Console releases[/h1]

Thanks to [url=https://crunchingkoalas.com/]Crunching Koalas[/url], the game is also available on PS4 and XBox One! The list of consoles we support might grow in the future, but we can't tell you anything about that yet.

[b]Also, prepare for Summer Sale starting in a few hours. Let's hope it will bring a little more gamers who like torturing pixel people as much as we do.[/b]

[h1]Remember about the level editor![/h1]

[b]We want to play some levels made by you too! If they're really good, maybe we'll add them to the official collection as free DLCs (giving you a credit for that).[/b]

notes.title: Leaderboards and gamepad update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/5d586820797b0088e32764609b8899d6ce49f10a.gif[/img]

We're happy to announce that we've just moved all beta features to the live production version, including better gamepad support and speedrun leaderboards!

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Better gamepad support:
   [list]
   [*]Supported gamepads and operating systems (the list might grow in the future) - if not on the list, it might work, but no guarantees (we have no way to test everything, especially on non-Windows platforms):
      [list]
      [*][b]Windows 7:[/b] XBox 360 (wired and wireless), XBox One, DS4, Logitech F310
      [*][b]Linux (Ubuntu 16.04, default driver):[/b] Xbox 360 (wireless)
      [*][b]OSX:[/b] Logitech XUSB, DS3
      [/list]

      [*]Slight auto-aim and rebindable gamepad layout.
      [*]Advanced settings for unrecognized gamepads (or not recognized  properly) - old "experimental" section.
      [*]Possibility to turn off gamepad menu navigation in cases of improperly recognized gamepads.
      [*]Possibility to change dead zones for walking and jumping.
      [*]No keyboard layout select popup if gamepad is used in-game.
   [/list]
   [*] Combo keys support - just press 2 or more keys in the key config prompt.
   [*] Multiple save files.
   [*] Speedrun leaderboards (or rather scoreboards) - you can beat levels again as fast as possible and compare your scores against others.
   [*] Level browser is accessible regardless of the progress of the game.
   [*] Fixed: shader compatibility issue that caused low framerate in rare cases.
   [*] Fixed: black screen issue (fix worked on Windows 8.1 and integrated Intel GPU).
   [*] Fixed: city 4 end-arena elevator bug.
   [*] Fixed: city 3 lighting didn't work properly from time to time.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/f693db362e56f293f019cedc72b798a2023b610d.gif[/img]

Also, we've prepared a new [b]easy mode DLC[/b] for people who aren't tough enough to enjoy the normal version of Butcher. Stay tuned for more info!

So go ahead, sit on your comfy couch and watch your victims lie in a pool of blood for days before they die from hunger or raging infection, whatever gets them first.

notes.title: Gamepad testing
notes.content:
We're working on better gamepad support, which is accessible in the beta branch (passphrase: "idontmindbugsinthisbranch").

I don't want to post it as an update yet, because of too little visible changes.

[b]What it introduces:[/b]
[list]
[*]Combo keys (also for keyboard users)
[*]Rebindable gamepad layout (similar to keyboard layout)
[*]Slight auto-aim
[*]More abstract way of expressing buttons of known gamepads (LEFTSTICK instead of JOYSTICKBUTTON9 for example, only in non-advanced menu)
[*]The "Gamepad (experimental)" renamed to "Gamepad (advanced)"
[*]Ability to turn off gamepad support in menu in case of non-supported gamepads messing with menu navigation (so you can plug it in and set it up properly)
[/list]

[b]Supported and tested gamepads:[/b]
Windows: XBox One, XBox 360, DS4

Other pads on other systems might work, but will likely require some tweaking in advanced options.

The gamepad bindings are saved (if different than default) in:
[b][game folder]\butcher_Data\StreamingAssets\Game\Joysticks[/b], so it's possible to share them.

[b]Known issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]Can't unbind the right stick from aiming yet (possible if you edit config file, I can tell you how to do it if you need it)
[*]"Use gamepad in-game" checkbox is still in "Gamepad (Advanced)", should be in "Gamepad" menu
[/list]

I'm not a gamepad player myself, so I still find the style harder than mouse + keyboard and I can't probably judge whether it's good enough or still needs tweaks (I can play the game on "the hardest" difficulty without that many problems though). It would be awesome if you could give me some feedback :)

notes.title: Speedrun mode beta testing
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/f401326f5b0610d7c552aaa3bc34b2784db18312.gif[/img]

[b]Can you beat this level faster?[/b]

If you want to test your abilities on how fast you can complete each level (apart from the whole game), we're working on a speedrun mode for additional end-game challenge (and a bit of competition too!).

It's already working, though still very crude and we need the database to get populated with records. It's coupled with Steam, but it's not exactly Steam's leaderboards, as we wanted to achieve something different.

If you want to test it, we open the beta branch for everyone who's interested. The passphrase is "[b]idontmindbugsinthisbranch[/b]". We require it so you don't accidentally switch to it if you don't intend to.

This branch will have more frequent updates and you will be able to see what we are working on to further improve the game.

For now, you need to complete the game on at least hard difficulty to gain access to the level browser (though we'll do some changes in this matter as well). Then, every time you click on the level, you switch to the speedrun menu and can speedrun that particular level. Only your best no-death run counts in this mode.

Don't be scared that the speedrun menu seems to look weird, the histogram of scores will start making sense after several records of unique players. that's how it's gonna look like after a considerable amount of records (but likely with different distribution):
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/7e4fb81777ab036a662ff3376e281510103c1c2e.png[/img]

So, enjoy propelling yourself with your trusty chainsaw while cutting your enemies' faces off.
